Winning Pinckert takes the balance negative by exactly Lokonga's market value, and the sale that clears it is break-even to the euro with no margin whatever. The exposure is therefore not the leverage itself - there is ample time to unwind it - but tonight's market-value tick, which moves the size of the unwind after the bid is already committed and before the auction resolves. If Lokonga's value falls and the offer is not reduced to match, Georg wins the player and scores zero for the whole matchday. Direction is genuinely uncertain: his very recent value drift is flat while his longer drift is negative, and the return news is information no tick has priced yet, so a rise is equally plausible - in which case the offer should be raised, which would put Georg inside the contested clearing band for the first time.

verdict.detail: One live position, one timed action, and nothing else worth doing. Georg's offer for Elversberg centre-back Lukas Pinckert is still standing and still uncontested, and it is already pinned at the maximum survivable level - it equals his cash plus Sambi Lokonga's market value exactly, because only one sale may accompany one buy while keeping the squad at eleven, and Lokonga is the largest acceptable sale. That leaves the structure with no margin at all, which is the whole story of this run: tonight's market-value update lands well before the auction resolves, and if Lokonga's value falls at that tick, winning Pinckert opens a negative balance that his sale can no longer clear. A negative balance at the matchday lock scores zero for the entire matchday, so the single action that matters is to re-read Lokonga's value after the tick and reset the Pinckert offer to cash plus his new value - down if it fell, up if it rose. Everything else on the board is logged as an avoid.

sell.reason: Lokonga remains the recommended sale, but the reason has changed and this reverses what a previous run recorded. He is no longer an availability case. Two dated sources this morning quote coach Polzin saying the back problem came from a single mistimed movement in closing training, that he expects it resolved at the start of the week, and that he expects the player back in team training and available at Leipzig; the league-wide absentee table no longer lists him among HSV's missing. Kickbase still carries an injury flag on him and that flag is stale. What the sale now rests on is weaker but still sound: his average is the lowest of any fielded outfielder bar Widmer, it comes off a single appearance, Bilal Nadir started in his place and holds it, and being available is not the same as starting - the same reports call his Leipzig participation a race against time. Above all it rests on arithmetic: his market value is the only unwind that clears the Pinckert overhang. A correction to the standing plan - Conte does not substitute as the unwind leg. Selling him instead leaves the balance short of zero, which means no points at all for the matchday. Widmer is far too small to serve, and selling both drops the squad below eleven. Lokonga is forced by the arithmetic rather than chosen on merit, and the sale stays conditional on the buy landing first.
